Diego (Support): Escalation: trial tenant AuroraData seeing embed failures after SSO rollout. Reports from their QA: ~60% 502s on embed requests over the last 90m. Renewal call in 7 days, they're running a full ingest test this afternoon. Ticket T-10022.
Priya (CS): Thanks Diego — can you paste a short impact summary, what we've tried, and the primary customer contact? We need a one-paragraph customer note and an internal comms checklist.
Diego (Support): Impact summary: embed success rate dropped from ~96% to ~38% since SSO change. Logs show repeated: "POST /v1/embeds -> 502 Bad Gateway: shard overflow -> OOM fallback". Attempts: cycled pool (no effect), increased per-request timeout to 45s (no effect), rolled back config to older agent (no change). Contact: Rowan Kim (rowan@auroradata.io), timezone EST.
Nate (Eng): Likely noisy neighbor + cache thrash after identity keys changed. Short-term mitigation: route AuroraData to a dedicated burst pool and pin to rwd-embed-3b-legacy variant. Also increase embedding cache TTL for their tenant. Proposed delta to routing:
```
- match: tenant=auroradata
  action: route->shared
+ match: tenant=auroradata
  action: route->dedicated-burst-3
  model_pin: rwd-embed-3b-legacy
  cache_ttl: 3600
```
I can stage the change but Ops needs to provision pool.
Laura (Ops): I can provision a 3-hour burst pool (1xA10G) and attach them. Need AE/Tier approval to consume reserved units. If approved I'll stand it up and post a test command to validate.
Priya (CS): Diego, please draft the customer-facing blurb (2 sentences + ETA). Also add whether we should proactively offer a credit for disruption. I'll coordinate the outreach once Ops confirms.
Diego (Support): Draft for customer (Priya to send): "Hi Rowan — we noticed elevated errors from our embeddings endpoint after your SSO configuration. We're applying a mitigation (temporary dedicated pool + model pin) within the next 90 minutes and will update you by 15:30 ET. Apologies for the interruption; we will follow up with a detailed RCA." :handshake: 
Priya (CS): Tweak: add cc cs@redwood.com and offer a 10% trial credit for impacted test runs. Also propose a 30-minute sync after the mitigation window to validate. I'll send when Ops confirms.
alert-bot: incident channel created -> https://zoom.redwood/bridge/BRG-10022 (auto). Use this for the 15:30 sync.
Laura (Ops): Provisioning burst-burst-3 now. ETA ~12 minutes. Smoke test command I'll run (support console):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeds -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"input":"smoke test"}' | jq '.status, .latency_ms'
```
Expect: "ok" and latency <200ms. Posting when done.
Laura (Ops): burst-burst-3 provisioned and attached. Initial smoke: status "ok", latency 150ms, 20/20 success.
Diego (Support): Confirmed from support console: repeated calls show success 100% and median latency ~165ms. Sending Priya the draft to send to Rowan. Captured request IDs for RCA.
Priya (CS): Outreach sent to Rowan (cc cs@redwood.com). Internal comms checklist (I'll own): 1) notify AE + renewal owner, 2) schedule 15:30 bridge + run customer tests, 3) offer 10% credit against trial overage, 4) collect feedback and include in renewal risk note, 5) open RCA repo and assign Eng owner within 48h. Marking Priority: High. Any edits?
Nate (Eng): Add action: evaluate automated model-pin for all trial tenants + telemetry alert when embed error rate >15% for 30m. I'll file a tech task.
Priya (CS): Good add. Final notes: capture verbatim customer feedback from bridge and paste here after the call so CS can update the renewal playbook. Thanks everyone.
Laura (Ops): Closing loop: pool will auto-decommission at the 3-hour mark unless we extend. Ping me here if you want an extension.
Priya (CS): We'll decide post-sync. If customer expresses high frustration, we escalate to AE for executive touch. Diego, please post the bridge notes + any logs we promised.
Diego (Support): Will do. Posting logs to incident repo and sharing link on the bridge after the call.
